text:
Priya: quick sync 0 — on phones the left rail collapse + table overflow is causing header to slide under the global topbar when the nav animates. noticed during testing. anyone seen this?

Jon: yup, users mentioned the header disappearing briefly. looks like a stacking context issue. :grimacing: 

Alex: probably because the nav uses `transform` to animate. transforms create new stacking contexts so a sticky header can end up behind.

Marta: from an accessibility angle we also lose keyboard focus when the nav collapses. focus should land in the main content area, not vanish.

Priya: proposed fixes: make the table header `position: sticky` with high z-index; animate the nav using `max-width` or inner-wrapper width rather than translate; add an `aria-live` announcement when layout shifts.

Alex: animating `max-width` can feel janky on low-end devices. alternative: keep an outer rail at full width but animate an inner container's width and clip overflow. snippet: `@media (max-width:720px){ .rail-inner{ width:240px; transition:width .18s ease; } .rail-inner.collapsed{ width:0; } .table-head{position:sticky; top:56px; z-index:800}}`

Jon: breakpoint thoughts: dense icon rail at <920, hide fully at <640. keeps parity with our mobile tokens.

Marta: copy nits: toggle tooltip says "Hide nav" in some places and "Collapse sidebar" in others. prefer "Collapse sidebar". overflow actions currently mix "More" and "Show more" 0 0 standardize to "Show more".

Priya: good catches. Also ensure toggle has `aria-expanded` and the tooltip is tied to the button element. aria-live text could be: "Layout changed: sidebar collapsed".

Design-bot: icon pack v3 uploaded to /design/icons 0 might change collapsed iconography.

Alex: I'll open a tiny PR with sticky header z-index, inner-wrapper animation, and aria-live region. will include a short test plan.

Jon: one more UX decision: should horizontal swipe on table rows trigger sidebar collapse? testing showed accidental collapses when swiping rows for actions.

Marta: avoid that. keep swipe-to-collapse limited to the nav hit area and add an explicit handle. row swipes remain for row actions only.

Priya: decision noted: restrict swipe collapse to nav area, update copy to "Collapse sidebar", standardize overflow label to "Show more", move focus to main content on toggle. I'll update Figma and add micro-interaction notes. :white_check_mark:
